authority_note: This file declares no host topology of its own. Host identity, class and permitted workload classes come from deploy/oracle/resource-fabric/hosts.json (topology authority) and agent-system/orchestration/execution-fabric/constants.mjs HOST_ROLES (class vocabulary). Every bootstrap role below is keyed by the canonical host_id and carries the canonical host_class; every bootstrap workload maps to one or more canonical allowed_workload_classes (fabric_classes). roles/role-guard.mjs refuses a workload unless BOTH this adapter allows it AND hosts.json permits at least one of its fabric classes on the resolved host. provider-container is not a host: it is the ephemeral provider execution surface named by deploy/oracle/execution-fabric/provider-registry.json.

role_file.format: key=value lines: ROLE=<host_class> HOSTNAME=<host_id> NODE_ID=<host_id> FABRIC=PROVIDER_FIRST_EXECUTION_FABRIC REVISION=2.0

resolution_order: DIAL_HOST_ROLE environment variable (canonical host_id or host_class)
/etc/dial/host-role (root-owned, not group/world writable; ROLE class must equal hosts.json host_class for HOSTNAME and expectedRoleForHostname)
hostname exact match against hosts.json host_id (weak source; certification flags a missing role file)
otherwise UNKNOWN -> every governed workload is refused

dial-hermes-control.description: Hermes/control authority and primary cross-cloud recoverer: owner intake, Hermes runtime, mission control, VEKL orchestration, provider-first venue routing, OCI recovery and SSH brokering. oracle-admin remains independent cold recovery.

vekl-worker.description: Background coordination only: VEKL light research/cache refresh, structural snapshot extraction, light indexing, document processing, diagnostics. Never a control authority, never a Hermes runtime, never an owner-control endpoint, never heavy local compute.

oracle-admin.description: Recovery/admin only: OCI recovery, SSH brokering, break-glass, infrastructure health, policy ledger. Rejects all project work and every fallback venue role.

provider-container.description: Claude Code Remote / Codex cloud execution container. Ephemeral; carries bounded repository development on a topic branch, read-only repository context, evidence generation and PR workflow. No control home, no systemd, no Hermes runtime, no owner-control authority. Named by deploy/oracle/execution-fabric/provider-registry.json execution_surface values.

OWNER_CONTROL.description: typed dial_* owner controls, steering broker, WhatsApp adapters

HERMES_RUNTIME.description: Hermes manager runtime (Codex App Server / Claude Code exact slots)

VEKL_RESOLVE.description: engineering-knowledge resolution / activation for a packet

VEKL_RESEARCH.description: ahead-of-work presearch (model-backed forecast on the control host; allowlisted-source cache refresh on the background coordinator)

STRUCTURAL_SNAPSHOT.description: structural code-graph extraction (TypeScript baseline; Graphify only when qualified; always advisory)

OPERATOR_GATEWAY.description: chat-control HTTP MCP, operator stdio MCP

DETERMINISTIC_VERIFY.description: npm run verify and its sub-gates

REPOSITORY_WRITE.description: editing and committing the DIAL repository

WORKER_DISPATCH.description: dispatching a bounded job to the background coordinator over SSH

WORKER_JOB.description: executing an allowlisted worker job and returning a sealed receipt

DIAGNOSTICS.description: read-only host, service and repository inspection

OCI_RECOVERY.description: cloud console / OCI CLI recovery actions

BREAK_GLASS.description: emergency access and repair of other hosts

SSH_BROKER.description: brokering SSH into other estate hosts

RECOVERY_PEER.description: bounded reciprocal recovery of a peer host (R-class ceiling from hosts.json)
